tagline: Their name embroidered on a soft plush bed, stitched in so it survives the wash.
lead: Your dog gets a soft plush bed, and you get their name on it every time you walk past.
value: The name is embroidered, not printed, so it doesn't crack or peel, and it survives the washing.
intro: Fox is a personalised dog bed with your dog's name embroidered on it, a soft textured plush surface, fibre cushioning and a removable zipped cover, in seven sizes from XS to 3XL.
points: Stitched in rather than printed on, so it won't crack and peel.
Soft and textured where they lie.
Soft comfort rather than firm support.
The cover unzips and comes off to wash.
best_for: Dogs who like a soft bed, and anyone giving a gift that lands for a new puppy or a first Christmas.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. Not sure which of the seven sizes to take? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry it fully before refitting.
seo_title: Personalised Dog Bed with Embroidered Name | Snoozly
seo_description: Your dog's name embroidered, not printed, on a soft plush bed with fibre cushioning and a zipped, washable cover. Seven sizes, from XS to 3XL.
